title: Unusual transaction review
text: Review transactions when the amount is materially above the customer's observed pattern or when several authorization attempts occur in a short period. Corroborate with device and channel signals before escalation.

title: Cross-border activity on shared device
text: For cross-border activity on a device associated with multiple accounts, collect the authorization timeline and compare recent account activity. Route unresolved high-risk cases to a human investigator.

title: Repeat dispute indicator
text: A recent dispute is a supporting signal only. Do not treat a prior dispute as proof that a new transaction is unauthorized. Include the dispute history in the case context for reviewer assessment.
